text:
Eva (AE): Hey team — NeumannBank (EU enterprise) asked for SOC2 artifacts + a signed pen-test attestation for our POC. They also require proof of EU-only data residency for the POC and want to know pricing for a 3-week Dedicated pool with burst to ~50 RPS. Can Security + SE help?

Sam (SE): Quick clarifying q's: do they need logs retained >90 days? And will they supply a PO/SOW for the dedicated pool cost? Also which model do they want tested for the pen-test (we'll need model + quantization info).

Miguel (Security): We can provide a signed pen-test attestation letter and a controls checklist (SOC2 scope summary). Need answers: 1) redacted vs full pen-test report? 2) contact/email to address signature to. Timeline: 48–72 business hours once we have the attestation template + approver. Vulnerability details will be redacted in the attestation per policy unless they request a full report under NDA.

Jin (Solutions Eng): For pricing ballpark — Dedicated reserved capacity is monthly commit. Example: a 2x A100-equivalent pool is roughly $12,000/mo. Pro-rated for 3 weeks = ~$9,000. Add burst credit for peak concurrency; we typically add a 20% buffer (~$1.8k). If they prefer hosted usage, conservative token estimate for POC (300k tokens/day) would be ~ $X/day depending on model. Need model + expected QPS/seq-len to firm this up.

Eva (AE): They asked for 90-day logs retention and KMS integration. They will provide a PO but asked for numbers now. Contact for signature: "legal@neumannbank.eu". They would prefer a short attestation letter (not full report).

Teresa (Legal): FYI — we'll only sign an attestation confirming that a third-party pentest was completed and summarizing remediation posture. No raw vuln disclosure in a public letter. I'll need SOW/PO and the internal approver name. I can sign on company letterhead once Security approves the final text.

Miguel (Security): Draft attestation below — please confirm customer name and approver. I can swap to letterhead after review.

```
Pentest Attestation
Date: <DATE>
To: NeumannBank / legal@neumannbank.eu
This letter certifies that Redwood Inference contracted an independent penetration test of our inference platform (models: <MODEL LIST>) during the period <START> - <END>. The assessment was performed by <VENDOR> and covered network, infra, and API controls relevant to customer-facing POC deployments. Findings requiring remediation were addressed or mitigated per our remediation policy. Redwood confirms no unremediated critical vulnerabilities remained at time of attestation. Details of vulnerabilities are redacted and can be provided under NDA.
Signed,
Miguel - Head of Security, Redwood Inference
```

Jin (Solutions Eng): For the EU-data residency proof: we can enable eu-central-1 only for the POC and provide a config snippet to include in the SOW. Example snippet: 
```
deployment: private-dedicated
region: eu-central-1
data_residency: eu
kms: customer-managed
retention: 90d
```
Also: need model artifact hash and quantization level to include in pen-test scope.

deploy-bot: Created security ticket SEC-2026-89 for pen-test attestation and evidence handoff (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-2026-89).

Eva (AE): Thanks — I'm sending the PO now and confirming model (gpt-neon-2.7b-8bit) + expected peak seq len 1024. Please proceed with the attestation template and pricing quote so I can attach both to the PO. :thumbsup:

Miguel (Security): Received. Will prepare the signed attestation and checklist. Targeting EOD +2 business days.

Jin (Solutions Eng): I'll create a short cost appendix for the SOW with the pro-rated numbers and an optional burst line item. Sending draft in channel in 30m.

Teresa (Legal): I'll review the final attestation text before signature. Please loop me in on the draft.

Eva (AE): Awesome — I'll update NeumannBank and post the PO here once it's in.
